notes: Summary: Enterprise contact-center vendor focused on outsourcing+SaaS for large ecommerce customers. Primary buyer: Head of CX Ops (Marcus Hale). They need a dedicated inference pool for 24/7 operations (reserved throughput) with strict isolation (VPC/private) and regional residency (US-west primary). Workloads: real-time agent assist (short prompts, few-hundred-token context), ticket summarization (background jobs), tool-calling into Zendesk/Salesforce, and nightly reranking pipelines for routing. Performance targets: p95 latency < 300ms for agent-assist simple completions; sustain 200-400 concurrent active agents with burst capacity to 700. Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit to reserved capacity in exchange for predictable unit economics. Security/compliance: SOC2 required, ISO27001 preferred, SSO/SAML, KMS integration, audit logs and retention controls. POC notes: 30-day POC used a quantized Llama-family model; accuracy OK, tail latency revealed need for KV caching + smarter routing (hot model variant for peak). Engineering asks: kernel-level tuning (sequence length distribution), fallback model variants, metrics hooks for token-level billing in Console. Legal asks: explicit data residency and retention appendix, incident notification SLA. Next steps: commercial proposal for Dedicated (capacity tiers + burst), SLO appendix, legal/data residency call, finalize procurement timeline (target close: 2026-03).
